definitions.gloss: closing time; closing of a facility for the day
definitions.explanation: The daily closing of a facility such as a library, museum, or public building at the end of operating hours.

definitions.gloss: permanent closure; shutting down of a facility
definitions.explanation: The permanent closing of a building or facility that ceases operation entirely.

examples.japanese: {閉館|へいかん}{時間|じかん}は{何時|なんじ}ですか。
{図書館|としょかん}は{午後|ごご}{五時|ごじ}に{閉館|へいかん}する。
{閉館|へいかん}まであと{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}です。
examples.english: There are thirty minutes until closing.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}のため、{来年|らいねん}{閉館|へいかん}することが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: Due to deterioration, it was decided that the facility will close permanently next year.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{親|した}しまれた{映画館|えいがかん}が{閉館|へいかん}して、{惜|お}しむ{声|こえ}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: The beloved cinema that had been enjoyed for many years closed, and many voiced their regret.

examples.japanese: {閉館|へいかん}した{美術館|びじゅつかん}の{跡地|あとち}にマンションが{建|た}つらしい。
examples.english: Apparently an apartment building will be built on the site of the closed museum.

notes:
{閉館|へいかん} means the closing of a public facility such as a library, museum, or cinema. It covers both daily closing time and permanent shutdown.

WRITING:
{閉|へい} (close) + {館|かん} (large building/facility). The {館|かん} limits this word to public buildings — not shops or offices.

USAGE:
- Libraries ({図書館|としょかん}), museums ({美術館|びじゅつかん}), cinemas ({映画館|えいがかん}), gymnasiums ({体育館|たいいくかん})
- For shops, use {閉店|へいてん}
- For offices or schools, use {閉鎖|へいさ}

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {閉館|へいかん}{時間|じかん}: closing time
- {閉館|へいかん}{日|び}: closed day
- {閉館|へいかん}する: to close (for the day or permanently)

SIMILAR WORDS:
Antonym is {開館|かいかん} (opening of a facility).
